          Drop a .zip with your assets — screenshots, icon, README — and your package if it’s built. AI reads everything and drafts your whole submission for you to review.

          How to name things in your .zip
          • Package — your .msix / .appx (or .exe / .msi)
          • Icon — name it logo or icon
          • Cover image — name it hero or cover
          • Screenshots — any other images (e.g. screenshot-1.png)
          • Description — a README.md
          • What’s new — a CHANGELOG.md

          Folders are fine — AI looks everywhere inside the .zip.

          Nothing is submitted until you review and approve everything.

            Edit listing Done             Identity for your manifest

            Paste these into your AppxManifest.xml before building. They're locked to your reservation and never change.

            Download starter AppxManifest.xml Copy <Identity> snippet             How to build your package

            Package your app as an MSIX (.msix / .msixbundle) and drop it in the box above. Already have a .exe / .msi installer? Bring it as-is, or convert it to MSIX after upload. To build an MSIX, pick how:

            1. Install the Windows SDK. It gives you makeappx and signtool.
            2. Set your identity. In AppxManifest.xml, match the Name and Publisher to your reservation.
            3. Build.makeappx pack /d YourAppFolder /p App.msix
            4. Sign.signtool sign /fd SHA256 /a /f cert.pfx App.msix
            5. Upload the signed App.msix in the box above.
            Full walkthrough

            Prefer a GUI, or already have an installer? These also produce a valid MSIX.

            • Visual Studio

              Add a Windows Application Packaging Project, then Publish → Create App Packages. Your identity fills in automatically.

              Guide
            • MSIX Packaging Tool

              Repackage an existing .exe / .msi installer into MSIX.

              Guide
            • Advanced Installer & others

              Most installer tools can output MSIX — set the package Name and Publisher to match your reservation.

            Your package's Name and Publisher must match your Store reservation exactly, or the upload is rejected.
